findings.title: First text filter on a run ends the group selection although the group still exists
findings.repro: Run a test; Group = Model Pair; click the group row body (group selected, aggregate shown); type any text filter that still matches some of the group's clashes (first text filter since the run, i.e. label index cold), e.g. 'Duct' on the Mech self run.
findings.expected: §27.2/AC-GP10: the group still exists in the filtered list, so its selection is kept and its current filtered membership is re-presented.
findings.actual: MutationObserver trace: t0 group shown/selected; t+159ms results 'No clashes match the current filters.' and selected region empty; t+165ms group back as '(213 of 242)' but selection stays null and aggregate isolation cleared ({5:365} -> {}). Reproduced twice (S6-first-text-filter-after, F1-repro2). With a warm label index (second and later filters) the selection survives (GP-13).
findings.likelyCause: controller.js setFilter -> refreshList runs the text filter pass before ensureLabelIndex has warmed the label index; that cold pass matches nothing, rebuildOrdered -> reconcileSelectedGroup sees the group missing and calls endGroupSelection (permanent); the warm pass ~6 ms later restores the group but not the selection. The same cold pass also ends a single-clash navScope for good (pre-existing).
evidence: state-captures.json: S6-start, S6-filter-applied-membership-recomputed (mis-tagged; it is this finding's first occurrence), S6-first-text-filter-after, F1-repro2-presented

observations.text: Aggregate restore after Isolate (group or single clash) restores the exact external isolated ids but leaves non-isolated models root-hidden where they were previously plain visible. Pre-existing (reproduced on single-clash path); isolation.js is protected; not an Addendum B regression.

viewer.hideModel(Structure) while the 3-model group was shown: group context kept '25 participants', no unavailable note, Isolate still applied on Arch/Mech ({1:2, 3:21}); Focus re-presented the same; showModel left Structure fully visible and un-isolated beside the isolated Arch/Mech. Single-clash path behaves the same for isolation (markers removed, isolation residue kept) and hideModel keeps the model in getAllModels/catalog — same root ambiguity as CTM-7 F-1 (hideModel = departure or not). Not classified as an Addendum B defect; depends on the owner's F-1 decision.
No-live group: the disabled Isolate checkbox still renders checked (toggle preference) beside the 'Viewer actions are unavailable' reason. Cosmetic; matches the shared toggle semantics.

Metadata groupings (Category/Level) become unavailable when any run model unloads, so the 'retain truthful group context after departure' path is only reachable in Model Pair (and Element if it survives); verified there.
